primary_source.title: WAREX: Web Agent Reliability Evaluation on Existing Benchmarks
primary_source.venue_confirmation: Microsoft Research publication page and TMLR/OpenReview PDF
scope_notes: The same benchmark setups are compared under proxy/no-fault versus injected network/server faults, making this substantially stronger than an unmatched cross-system comparison for the tested fault models.

Prompting for fault handling only partially recovers several settings and can be worse than the untreated fault condition in at least one reported REAL network-error cell; therefore generic recovery prompting is not a universal mitigation.
Do not transfer the relative drops to arbitrary browser agents, production sites, or fault distributions outside WAREX.

assessment.reason: Peer-reviewed primary evidence with controlled matched fault/no-fault interventions across three established web-agent benchmarks and exact quantitative failure magnitudes. This is strong scoped negative evidence for environment robustness. Independent reproduction of the same fault injections was not verified here, so scope remains the tested agents/benchmarks/fault models.
assessment.replication_status: no independent exact-method replication verified in this pass
